#### ARTICLE 383

A Judge who does not give course to a petition, lawsuit, accusation, complaint or denunciation presented in legal form or who maliciously or irresponsibly delays the administration of justice, shall be sanctioned with special disqualification from three (3) to six
(6) years.

#### ARTICLE 384

The public official or employee who, failing in the obligations of his office, does not adopt the necessary measures to achieve the detention and prosecution of a presumed offender, shall be sanctioned with a fine of thirty thousand (L.30,000.00) to sixty thousand Lempiras (L.60,000.00) and special disqualification from three (3) to six (6) years.

### CHAPTER XI

FALSE TESTIMONY, FALSE ACCUSATION AND DENUNCIATION

#### ARTICLE 385

The witness, expert or interpreter who in his deposition, report, translation or interpretation, made before competent authority, totally or partially falsifies the truth or conceals it, shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from three (3) to five (5) years.

The sanction shall be from three (3) to six (6) years, if the false testimony is committed in a criminal case to the detriment of the accused.

In all cases, absolute disqualification from three (3) to eight (8) years shall also be imposed.

#### ARTICLE 386

Whoever knowingly presents false witnesses in court shall incur the respective penalties of the preceding article.

#### ARTICLE 387

The crime of false accusation or denunciation is committed when facts are imputed to a person which, if true, would constitute crimes that give rise to ex officio proceedings, if the imputation is made before an administrative or judicial official who by reason of his office must proceed to its investigation or punishment. However, proceedings may not be brought against the denouncer or accuser except after the case has been dismissed or an acquittal has been rendered.
False accusation or denunciation shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from three (3) to six (6) years.

### CHAPTER XII

CONCEALMENT

#### ARTICLE 388

Whoever, without prior agreement with the authors or accomplices of a crime, but with sufficient reasons to suppose its commission, shall incur imprisonment from three (3) to five (5) years:
1)	Conceals the offender or facilitates his flight to avoid his prosecution;
2)	Procures the disappearance of evidence of the crime;

3)	Keeps, hides, buys, sells or receives in pledge or exchange the effects or instruments of the crime;
4)	Denies the authority, without justified reason, permission to enter his domicile to capture the offender who is found therein;

5)	Fails to communicate to the authority the information he may have about the commission of any crime when he is obliged to do so by his profession or employment. In this case, in addition to the established sanction, special disqualification for double the time of the imprisonment shall be imposed; or

6)	Assists the authors or accomplices to benefit from the product or price of objects arising from the crime or personally takes advantage of the mentioned product or price.

When the concealment is executed with intent to profit, the penalty shall be increased by one third. If the concealer executes the acts referred to in this Article habitually, the penalty shall be increased by fifty percent (50%).

#### ARTICLE 389

Those who are concealers of their spouse or of the person with whom they live as married, or of their relatives within the fourth degree of consanguinity or second degree of affinity, shall not be sanctioned, except when they have taken advantage themselves or have assisted the offenders to take advantage of the effects of the crime.

### CHAPTER XIII

ESCAPE

#### ARTICLE 390

Whoever escapes while legally detained or convicted shall be sanctioned in addition with imprisonment from five (5) to ten (10) years. If the escape is produced by means of intimidation or violence against persons or force against things, the penalty shall be increased by one third, without prejudice to the sanction that must be applied to the crimes to which the intimidation, violence or force give rise.

#### ARTICLE 391

Whoever collaborates in the escape of a detainee or convict shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from five (5) to ten (10) years. If the person who has favored the escape is a public servant, in addition to the increase by one third in the penalty for his condition as such, special disqualification for double the time established for imprisonment shall be imposed.

However, they are exempt from criminal liability if the person who collaborates in the escape of a detainee or convict is his spouse or person with whom he lives as married, or his relatives within the fourth degree of consanguinity or second degree of affinity, of the person who has escaped, excepting public servants.

#### ARTICLE 392

The custodian through whose fault the escape of a detainee or convict has occurred shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from one (1) to three (3) years. If the escape is through the fault of the warden or other penitentiary official, the imprisonment shall be from three (3) to six
(6) years.
If the escape is produced by fraud of the custodian, warden or other penitentiary official or employee, it shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from four (4) to nine (9) years, a fine of fifty thousand (L.50,000.00) to seventy thousand lempiras (L.70,000.00), plus special disqualification for double the time of the imprisonment.

### CHAPTER XIV GENERAL PROVISION

#### ARTICLE 393

For all purposes of this Code, every natural person who, by provision of law or by appointment of competent authority, participates in the exercise of public functions or performs a public office or employment shall be deemed a public official or employee.
Municipal mayors and aldermen shall also be deemed public officials. BOOK THREE
INFRACTIONS

## TITLE I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### ARTICLE 394

The provisions contained in Book One of this Code are applicable to infractions, as pertinent, with the following modifications:
1)	Only infractions committed in the national territory are punishable.

2)	Only consummated infractions are punished.

3)	Only the authors are liable for infractions.
4)	Conditional suspension of sentence shall be applicable to imprisonment imposed for infractions, during a probationary period of two years.

5)	The security measures established in Article 83 of this Code may be applied to the authors of infractions, but in no case shall it exceed one year.
6)	Recidivism in infractions may not be assessed after one year has elapsed from the date of the conviction.

7)	The confiscation of the instruments and effects of infractions shall be decreed by the courts at their prudent discretion according to the circumstances.

#### ARTICLE 395

The judge may exempt from penalty in the sentence whoever commits an infraction for the first time, when due to the lightness of the act, the determining motives and the minimal dangerousness of the subject, there are probabilities that he will not offend again, without prejudice to the corresponding civil liability.

## TITLE II

INFRACTIONS AGAINST PERSONS

#### ARTICLE 396. Shall be sanctioned with imprisonment from thirty to ninety days

1)	Whoever causes another injuries that produce illness or incapacity for work for up to ten days.
2)	Whoever, finding a minor under twelve years of age abandoned or lost, does not notify his family or the authority, or fails to take him to a safe place within forty-eight hours following the finding.

3)	Whoever in a tumultuous brawl has exercised any violence on the person of the offended party, provided that the latter has not suffered more injuries than those mentioned in the first numeral of this Article, and it is not established who was its author.

4)	Parents or legal guardians, whose faculties permit them, who do not provide the necessary means to give education to their children while they are minors.

text:
#### ARTICULO 397

Incurrirán en la pena señalada en el artículo anterior, si el hecho no estuviere comprendido en el Libro Segundo de este Código.

1)	Quien no socorriere o auxiliare a una persona que encontrare en despoblado, herida o en peligro de perecer, cuando pudiere hacerlo sin riesgo o detrimento propio.

2)	Quien de palabra, en el ímpetu de la ira, amenazare a otro con causarle un mal que constituye delito, y por sus actos posteriores demuestre que no persiste en la idea que significó con su amenaza.

3)	Quien causare a otro una coacción o vejación injusta.
4)	Los cónyuges que escandalizaren con sus disensiones domésticas.

Lo dicho de los cónyuges se aplica al hombre y a la mujer que hacen vida marital.

5)	Quien amenazare a otro con arma, o la sacare en riña como no sea en justa defensa.

#### ARTICULO 398. Sufrirá prisión de quince a sesenta días

1)	Quien causare lesiones que no impidan al ofendido dedicarse a su trabajo habitual.

2)	Quien maltratare a su esposa o a la mujer con quien hace vida marital, cuando no le produzca lesión.
3)	Quien apedreare a alguna persona o le arrojare objetos o sustancias sin causarle daño.

4)	Quien acometiere a una mujer encinta, sin causarle daño, cuando el embarazo fuere notorio, o le constare su estado.
5)	Quien golpeare o maltratare de obra a una persona sin causarle lesión.

6)	Quien de palabra amenazare a otro con causarle un mal que no constituya delito.
7)	Los padres o guardadores que se excedieren en la corrección de sus hijos o pupilos; siempre que no les causen lesiones.

8)	Los guardadores que abandonaren a sus pupilos exponiéndolos a la corrupción o no procurándoles asistencia y educación.

#### ARTICULO 399. Será penado con prisión de diez a treinta días

1)	La mujer que maltratare de obra o de palabra a su marido o compañero de vida marital, sin causarle lesión.
2)	Quien se hiciere acompañar por menores de dieciocho años en la vagancia o la mendicidad, o los hiciere trabajar con infracción de las leyes laborales.

3)	Quien injuriare a otro levemente, si lo reclama el ofendido, cuyo perdón extinguirá la pena. Son aplicables, en su caso, los Artículos 159 y 163.
4)	Quien requerido por otro u otros para evitar un mal, dejare de prestar el auxilio reclamado, si no hubiere de resultar perjuicio alguno.

## TITULO III

FALTAS CONTRA LA PROPIEDAD

#### ARTICULO 400. Será sancionado con prisión de treinta a noventa días

1)	Quien cometiere hurto de muebles cuyo valor no exceda de diez lempiras.

2)	El autor de defraudación que cause perjuicio patrimonial no mayor de diez lempiras.
3)	Quien encontrándose una cosa perdida no la entregare a la autoridad o a su dueño si supiere quien lo es y se la apropiare con intención de lucro, cuando su valor no exceda de diez lempiras.

4)	Quien por interés o lucro interpretare sueños, hiciere pronósticos o adivinaciones, o abusare de la credulidad pública de otra manera semejante.
5)	Quien obtenga fraudulentamente una prestación o servicio a sabiendas de que no puede pagarlos, si su valor no excediere de diez lempiras.

6)	Quien adquiere objetos de procedencia sospechosa, comprados aun menor o a una persona de la que se puede presumir que no es su legítimo propietario.

7)	Quien destruyere, menoscabare o perjudicare una cosa ajena causándole daño que no exceda de diez lempiras.

#### ARTICULO 401. Será sancionado con prisión de uno a veinte días

1)	Quien entrare en heredad o campo ajeno para coger frutos y comerlos en el acto.

2)	Quien en la misma forma cogiere frutos, mieses y otros productos forestales para hecharlos en el acto a caballería o ganado, si el valor no excede de diez lempiras.
3)	Quien sin permiso del dueño entrare en heredad o campo ajeno, antes de haber levantado por completo las cosechas, para aprovecharse del espigueo y otros restos de aquellas.

4)	Quien entre en heredad ajena cercada, si estuviere manifiesta la prohibición de entrar.

5)	Quien entrare a cazar o pescar en heredad cerrada o campo vedado sin permiso del dueño.

6)	Quien con cualquier motivo o pretexto atravesare plantíos o sembrados sin permiso del dueño.

7)	Quien llevando vehículos de cualquier clase, caballerías o animales dañinos, cometiere alguno de los excesos previstos en los dos incisos procedentes, si por razón del daño no mereciere mayor pena.

8)	Quien destruyere o destrozare choza, albergue, setos, cercas, vallados u otros defensas de las propiedades, si el hecho no mereciere mayor pena.

9)	Quien causare daños arrojando piedras, materiales o proyectiles de cualquier clase, si el hecho no mereciere mayor pena.

#### ARTICULO 402

Será sancionado con multa de quinientos (L.500.00) a novecientos Lempiras (L.900.00), el dueño de ganados que entren en heredad o campo ajeno cercado

y causen daño. Si no causan daño, la multa será de doscientos (L.200.00) a quinientos lempiras (L.500.00).

#### ARTICULO 403

Si los ganados fueren introducidos de propósito, o por abandono o negligencia de los dueños o encargados, además de pagar éstos la multa últimamente expresada, sufrirán en sus respectivos casos, prisión de treinta a noventa días, salvo que el hecho constituyere delito.

#### ARTICULO 404

Será sancionado con la pena de prisión de treinta a noventa días quien ejecutare incendio de cualquier clase que no esté penado en el Libro Segundo de este Código.

#### ARTICULO 405

Será sancionado con multa de cien (L.100.00) a cuatrocientos lempiras (L.400.00):
1)	Quien infrinja los reglamentos u ordenanzas sobre quema de rastrojos o de bienes o productos forestales; y,

2)	Quien infrinja las ordenanzas sobre caza y pesca.

#### ARTICULO 406

Quien ocasione daños cuyo valor no exceda de quinientos lempiras (L.500.00), será sancionado con una multa igual al doble del respectivo valor.

Si el autor del daño sustrae o utiliza los objeto o frutos del daño causado, además de la multa prevista en el párrafo anterior será sancionado con prisión de veinte (20) a treinta
(30) días.

#### ARTICULO 407. (DEROGADO)

#### ARTICULO 408

Quien aprovechando aguas que pertenezcan a otro o distrayéndolas de su curso, causare daño cuyo importe no exceda de diez lempiras, incurrirá en prisión de cinco a veinte días.

#### ARTICULO 409

Quien intencionalmente, por negligencia o por descuido cause un daño cualquiera no penado en este libro ni en el anterior, será castigado con multa de cien (L.100.00) a doscientos lempiras (L.200.00).

## TITULO IV

FALTAS CONTRA LAS BUENAS COSTUMBRES

#### ARTICULO 410

Será castigado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de setecientos (L.700.00) a un mil Lempiras (L.1,000.00):

1)	Quien ofenda el pudor en forma pública;

2)	Quien se exhiba desnudo ofendiendo la decencia pública;
3)	Quien se embriague y provoque escándalo o ponga en peligro la seguridad propia o la de los demás. Si la embriaguez fuese habitual, el juez podrá aplicar la medida de seguridad que considere adecuada; y,

4)	Quien en sitios públicos se dirija a una mujer en forma soez o con frases o proposiciones irrespetuosas; o la molestare con hechos o actitudes ofensivas al pudor.

## TITULO V

FALTAS CONTRA LOS INTERESES GENERALES Y REGIMEN DE LAS POBLACIONES
translated_text:
#### ARTICLE 397

Those who commit the following acts shall incur the penalty indicated in the preceding article, if the act is not covered in Book Two of this Code.

1) Whoever does not aid or assist a person found in an uninhabited place, injured or in danger of perishing, when able to do so without risk or detriment to oneself.

2) Whoever verbally, in the heat of anger, threatens another with causing harm that constitutes a crime, and by subsequent acts demonstrates that he or she does not persist in the idea signified by the threat.

3) Whoever causes another unjust coercion or vexation.
4) Spouses who scandalize with their domestic disputes.

What is said of spouses applies to the man and woman who live together as a couple.

5) Whoever threatens another with a weapon, or draws it in a fight except in lawful self-defense.

#### ARTICLE 398. Shall suffer imprisonment of fifteen to sixty days

1) Whoever causes injuries that do not prevent the victim from engaging in his or her habitual work.

2) Whoever mistreats his wife or the woman with whom he lives as a couple, when it does not produce injury.
3) Whoever throws stones at any person or throws objects or substances at them without causing harm.

4) Whoever assaults a pregnant woman, without causing harm, when the pregnancy is evident, or the condition is known to him.
5) Whoever strikes or physically mistreats a person without causing injury.

6) Whoever verbally threatens another with causing harm that does not constitute a crime.
7) Parents or guardians who exceed the correction of their children or wards; provided they do not cause them injuries.

8) Guardians who abandon their wards exposing them to corruption or not providing them assistance and education.

#### ARTICLE 399. Shall be punished with imprisonment of ten to thirty days

1) The woman who mistreats physically or verbally her husband or partner in marital life, without causing injury.
2) Whoever has minors under eighteen years of age accompany him or her in vagrancy or begging, or makes them work in violation of labor laws.

3) Whoever slightly insults another, if claimed by the victim, whose pardon shall extinguish the penalty. Articles 159 and 163 are applicable, as the case may be.
4) Whoever, requested by another or others to prevent harm, fails to provide the aid requested, if no prejudice is to result.

## TITLE III

OFFENSES AGAINST PROPERTY

#### ARTICLE 400. Shall be sanctioned with imprisonment of thirty to ninety days

1) Whoever commits theft of movable property whose value does not exceed ten lempiras.

2) The perpetrator of fraud that causes patrimonial damage not greater than ten lempiras.
3) Whoever finding a lost thing does not deliver it to the authority or to its owner if he or she knows who it is and appropriates it with intent to profit, when its value does not exceed ten lempiras.

4) Whoever for interest or profit interprets dreams, makes predictions or divinations, or abuses public credulity in another similar manner.
5) Whoever fraudulently obtains a benefit or service knowing that he or she cannot pay for them, if their value does not exceed ten lempiras.

6) Whoever acquires objects of suspicious origin, purchased from a minor or from a person who can be presumed not to be their legitimate owner.

7) Whoever destroys, diminishes or damages another's property causing damage that does not exceed ten lempiras.

#### ARTICLE 401. Shall be sanctioned with imprisonment of one to twenty days

1) Whoever enters another's land or field to pick fruits and eat them on the spot.

2) Whoever in the same manner picks fruits, crops and other forest products to feed them on the spot to horses or livestock, if the value does not exceed ten lempiras.
3) Whoever without the owner's permission enters another's land or field, before the crops have been completely harvested, to take advantage of gleaning and other remains thereof.

4) Whoever enters another's enclosed land, if the prohibition to enter is manifest.

5) Whoever enters to hunt or fish in enclosed land or prohibited field without the owner's permission.

6) Whoever for any reason or pretext crosses plantings or crops without the owner's permission.

7) Whoever carrying vehicles of any kind, horses or harmful animals, commits any of the excesses provided in the two preceding subsections, if by reason of the damage does not merit greater penalty.

8) Whoever destroys or damages huts, shelters, hedges, fences, enclosures or other defenses of properties, if the act does not merit greater penalty.

9) Whoever causes damage by throwing stones, materials or projectiles of any kind, if the act does not merit greater penalty.

#### ARTICLE 402

Shall be sanctioned with a fine of five hundred (L.500.00) to nine hundred Lempiras (L.900.00), the owner of livestock that enters another's enclosed land or field

and causes damage. If they do not cause damage, the fine shall be two hundred (L.200.00) to five hundred lempiras (L.500.00).

#### ARTICLE 403

If the livestock were introduced on purpose, or by abandonment or negligence of the owners or those in charge, in addition to paying the fine last mentioned, they shall suffer in their respective cases, imprisonment of thirty to ninety days, unless the act constitutes a crime.

#### ARTICLE 404

Shall be sanctioned with the penalty of imprisonment of thirty to ninety days whoever commits arson of any kind not punished in Book Two of this Code.

#### ARTICLE 405

Shall be sanctioned with a fine of one hundred (L.100.00) to four hundred lempiras (L.400.00):
1) Whoever violates the regulations or ordinances on burning of stubble or forest goods or products; and,

2) Whoever violates the ordinances on hunting and fishing.

#### ARTICLE 406

Whoever causes damage whose value does not exceed five hundred lempiras (L.500.00), shall be sanctioned with a fine equal to double the respective value.

If the perpetrator of the damage removes or uses the objects or fruits of the damage caused, in addition to the fine provided in the preceding paragraph shall be sanctioned with imprisonment of twenty (20) to thirty
(30) days.

#### ARTICLE 407. (REPEALED)

#### ARTICLE 408

Whoever taking advantage of waters that belong to another or diverting them from their course, causes damage whose amount does not exceed ten lempiras, shall incur imprisonment of five to twenty days.

#### ARTICLE 409

Whoever intentionally, through negligence or carelessness causes any damage not punished in this book or in the preceding one, shall be punished with a fine of one hundred (L.100.00) to two hundred lempiras (L.200.00).

## TITLE IV

OFFENSES AGAINST GOOD MORALS

#### ARTICLE 410

Shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of seven hundred (L.700.00) to one thousand Lempiras (L.1,000.00):

1) Whoever offends modesty in public form;

2) Whoever exhibits himself or herself naked offending public decency;
3) Whoever becomes intoxicated and provokes scandal or endangers his or her own safety or that of others. If the intoxication is habitual, the judge may apply the security measure deemed appropriate; and,

4) Whoever in public places addresses a woman in a vulgar manner or with disrespectful phrases or propositions; or bothers her with acts or attitudes offensive to modesty.

## TITLE V

OFFENSES AGAINST GENERAL INTERESTS AND REGIME OF POPULATIONS

heading_path: CODIGO PENAL DE HONDURAS DECRETO NUMERO 144-83
text:
#### ARTICULO 411. Será sancionado con prisión de diez a treinta días

1)	Quien omitiere cumplir con la responsabilidad sobre las personas que la ley haya sometido a su vigilancia.

2)	Quien habiendo recibido de buena fe moneda falsa y después de constarle su falsedad la hiciere circular en cantidad que no exceda de diez lempiras.
3)	Los dueños o encargados de establecimientos que expendieren o sirvieren bebidas o comestibles adulterados, perjudiciales a la salud, o no observaren en el uso y conservación en los utensilios, destinados al servicio, las reglas establecidas o las precauciones de costumbre cuando el hecho no constituya delito.

4)	Quienes infringieren las disposiciones sanitarias dictadas por autoridad sobre conducción de cadáveres y enterramientos, en los casos no previstos en el Libro Segundo de este Código.

5)	Quienes, con hechos, que no constituyan delito, profanaren los cadáveres, cementerios o lugares de enterramiento.

#### ARTICULO 412

Será sancionado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a un mil lempiras (L.1,000.00), el médico o estudiante de medicina, odontólogo o estudiante de odontología, farmacéutico o estudiante de química y farmacia, paramédico, enfermera o comadrona que, habiendo brindado asistencia a una persona respecto de la cual pueda sospecharse que ha participado en la comisión de un delito, no dé parte inmediatamente a la autoridad competente.

#### ARTICULO 413

Será sancionado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a un mil lempiras (L.1,000.00) quien infrinja los reglamentos u ordenanzas sobre elaboración y custodia de materiales inflamables o corrosivos o productos químicos que puedan causar estragos.

#### ARTICULO 414. En la forma prevista en el Artículo anterior será sancionado quien

1)	Infringiendo las órdenes de la autoridad no efectúa la reparación o demolición de edificios ruinosos, insalubres o de mal aspecto;

2)	Arroje a la calle o sitio público agua, piedras u otros objetos que puedan causar daño a las personas o a las cosas, si el hecho no tuviere señalada pena mayor en el libro precedente;

3)	Habiendo dejado escombros, materiales u otros objetos, o hecho pozos, zanjas o excavaciones en un lugar de tránsito público, no pone señales o bardas de protección o no alerta a los transeúntes sobre la existencia del peligro;

4)	En balcones, ventanas, pretiles u otros puntos exteriores de los edificios coloca o suspende objetos que, en caso de caerse, puedan causar daño a los transeúntes o vecinos;
5)	Con infracción de las disposiciones de tránsito o de policía conduce semovientes o vehículos de cualquier clase en lugares en los que haya concentración de personas; y,

6)	Conduce o deja en la vía pública una bestia de tiro, de carga o de carrera, o cualquier otro animal, sin haber tomado las precauciones suficientes para que no cause daño.

## TITULO VI

FALTAS RELATIVAS A LA EMISION DEL PENSAMIENTO

#### ARTICULO 415

Incurrirá en prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a mil Lempiras (L.1,000.00), quien:

1)	Divulgue noticias falsas de las que pueda resultar algún peligro para el orden público o daño a los intereses o al crédito del Estado, si el hecho no merece mayor pena; y,
2)	Sin cometer delito, incite en forma pública a la desobediencia de las leyes o de las autoridades constituidas, haga la apología de acciones u omisiones constitutivas de delito u ofenda la moral, las buenas costumbres o la decencia pública.

## TITULO VII

FALTAS CONTRA EL ORDEN PUBLICO

#### ARTICULO 416

Quien cause daño o deterioro a las calles, parques, jardines o paseos, al alumbrado público, a los acueductos o alcantarillados, a los servicios telefónicos o telegráficos; a los puentes u otras obras de infraestructura, dañen o se roben las señales viales u objetos de ornato, artísticos, monumentos históricos, arqueológicos o de utilidad pública o de recreación, aún cuando pertenezcan a particulares, será sancionado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a un mil lempiras (L.1,000.00), si el hecho por su gravedad no constituye delito.

#### ARTICULO 417

Será sancionado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a un mil lempiras (L.1,000.00) quien:

1)	Con palabras, gritos, silbidos fuertes o reiterados o mediante instrumentos sonoros o de cualquier otra forma perturbe el orden público, el normal funcionamiento de un tribunal de justicia u otra oficina estatal o el pacífico desarrollo de una reunión o manifestación o de otro acto público análogo, si el hecho por su gravedad no constituye delito;
2)	Anuncie desastres, accidentes o peligros inexistentes y con ello suscite alarma pública.

#### ARTICULO 418

Será sancionado con prisión de sesenta (60) a noventa (90) días y multa de ochocientos (L.800.00) a mil (L.1,000.00) Lempiras, quien:

1)	Mediante estampas o grabados o de cualquier otra manera ofende la moral y las buenas costumbres;

2)	Falte al respeto y consideración debidos a una autoridad pública o deje de observar una providencia legalmente emitida por razones de justicia, seguridad pública, orden público o de higiene;
3)	Ofende o desobedece a los agentes de la autoridad cuando actúen en el ejercicio de sus funciones;

4)	No preste a la autoridad pública el auxilio que reclame en caso de delito, incendio, naufragio, accidente, inundación u otra calamidad, pudiendo hacerlo sin daño ni riesgo personal;

5)	Con ruidos o algarazas o mediante instrumentos sonoros o señales acústicas perturbe las ocupaciones o el reposo de las personas; y,
6)	En lugar público o abierto al público o mediante el teléfono, timbres u otros medios sonoros, por impertinencia o por otro motivo reprobable, cause molestias o disgustos a una persona.

Lo dispuesto en este Artículo no se aplicará si por gravedad el hecho es constitutivo de delito.

#### ARTICULO 419

En igual pena que la establecida en el artículo anterior incurrirá quien ocultare su verdadero nombre, estado o domicilio a la autoridad o funcionario que se los preguntare por razón de su cargo.

#### ARTICULO 420

En la misma sanción del Artículo 413, incurrirá quien ejerciere sin títulos actos de una profesión que lo exija, cuando el hecho no tuviere señalada mayor pena en este Código o en otras leyes.
TITULO FINAL CAPITULO UNICO
DISPOSICIONES TRANSITORIAS Y FINALES

#### ARTICULO 421

Si de acuerdo con el presente Código los actos que se están juzgando o sobre los cuales no hubiere recaído sentencia, no constituyeren delito o falta, los tribunales dictarán sobreseimiento o la pena impuesta dejará de ejecutarse.

#### ARTICULO 422

Las penas de presidio, relegación, confinamiento y destierro aplicadas de conformidad con el Código Penal de 1906, otros Códigos y demás leyes especiales, serán sustituidas por la reclusión sin modificación alguna respecto a la duración de las mismas, salvo que las sanciones contempladas en el presente Código sean más benignas, en cuyo caso serán éstas las aplicables; asimismo, la pena de suspensión se convertirá de oficio en la de inhabilitación especial.

#### ARTICULO 423

Las instituciones de "Suspensión Condicional de la Ejecución de la Pena" y "La Libertad Condicional", serán aplicables a los que hubieren sido condenados en virtud de leyes anteriores.

#### ARTICULO 424

Los plazos establecidos en este Código para las prescripciones del delito, de la acción penal y de la pena se aplicarán a quienes hayan infringido Leyes penales anteriores, siempre que los referidos plazos fueren más favorables.

#### ARTICULO 425

Sólo las personas responsables por delitos, cuya pena máxima no excediere de cinco años, podrán ser oídas en libertad durante el proceso, si rinden la respectiva caución de conformidad con la ley.
translated_text:
#### ARTICLE 411. Shall be punished with imprisonment of ten to thirty days

1) Whoever fails to fulfill the responsibility over persons whom the law has placed under their supervision.

2) Whoever having received counterfeit money in good faith and after becoming aware of its falsity circulates it in an amount not exceeding ten lempiras.
3) Owners or managers of establishments who sell or serve adulterated beverages or foodstuffs harmful to health, or do not observe in the use and preservation of utensils intended for service, the established rules or customary precautions when the act does not constitute a crime.

4) Whoever violates the sanitary provisions issued by authority regarding the transportation of corpses and burials, in cases not provided for in Book Two of this Code.

5) Whoever, by acts that do not constitute a crime, desecrates corpses, cemeteries or burial places.

#### ARTICLE 412

Shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand lempiras (L.1,000.00), the physician or medical student, dentist or dental student, pharmacist or chemistry and pharmacy student, paramedic, nurse or midwife who, having provided assistance to a person regarding whom it may be suspected that they have participated in the commission of a crime, does not immediately report to the competent authority.

#### ARTICLE 413

Shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand lempiras (L.1,000.00) whoever violates the regulations or ordinances regarding the manufacture and custody of flammable or corrosive materials or chemical products that may cause havoc.

#### ARTICLE 414. In the manner provided in the preceding Article shall be punished whoever

1) Violating the orders of the authority does not carry out the repair or demolition of ruinous, unhealthy or unsightly buildings;

2) Throws into the street or public place water, stones or other objects that may cause harm to persons or things, if the act does not have a greater penalty assigned in the preceding book;

3) Having left debris, materials or other objects, or made pits, ditches or excavations in a place of public transit, does not place warning signs or protective barriers or does not alert passersby about the existence of the danger;

4) On balconies, windows, parapets or other exterior points of buildings places or suspends objects that, in case of falling, may cause harm to passersby or neighbors;
5) In violation of traffic or police provisions drives animals or vehicles of any kind in places where there is a concentration of persons; and,

6) Drives or leaves in the public thoroughfare a draft, pack or racing animal, or any other animal, without having taken sufficient precautions so that it does not cause harm.

## TITLE VI

VIOLATIONS RELATING TO THE EXPRESSION OF THOUGHT

#### ARTICLE 415

Shall incur imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand Lempiras (L.1,000.00), whoever:

1) Disseminates false news from which may result some danger to public order or harm to the interests or credit of the State, if the act does not merit a greater penalty; and,
2) Without committing a crime, publicly incites disobedience of the laws or of the constituted authorities, makes an apology for actions or omissions constituting a crime or offends morality, good customs or public decency.

## TITLE VII

VIOLATIONS AGAINST PUBLIC ORDER

#### ARTICLE 416

Whoever causes damage or deterioration to streets, parks, gardens or promenades, to public lighting, to aqueducts or sewers, to telephone or telegraph services; to bridges or other infrastructure works, damages or steals road signs or ornamental objects, artistic objects, historical, archaeological or public utility or recreational monuments, even when they belong to private individuals, shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand lempiras (L.1,000.00), if the act by its gravity does not constitute a crime.

#### ARTICLE 417

Shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand lempiras (L.1,000.00) whoever:

1) With words, shouts, loud or repeated whistles or by means of sound instruments or in any other way disturbs public order, the normal functioning of a court of justice or other state office or the peaceful development of a meeting or demonstration or other analogous public act, if the act by its gravity does not constitute a crime;
2) Announces disasters, accidents or nonexistent dangers and thereby causes public alarm.

#### ARTICLE 418

Shall be punished with imprisonment of sixty (60) to ninety (90) days and a fine of eight hundred (L.800.00) to one thousand (L.1,000.00) Lempiras, whoever:

1) By means of prints or engravings or in any other manner offends morality and good customs;

2) Fails to show the respect and consideration due to a public authority or fails to observe a provision legally issued for reasons of justice, public safety, public order or hygiene;
3) Offends or disobeys agents of authority when they act in the exercise of their functions;

4) Does not provide to the public authority the assistance it requests in case of crime, fire, shipwreck, accident, flood or other calamity, being able to do so without harm or personal risk;

5) With noises or uproar or by means of sound instruments or acoustic signals disturbs the occupations or rest of persons; and,
6) In a public place or place open to the public or by means of the telephone, doorbells or other sound means, by impertinence or for another reprehensible reason, causes annoyance or displeasure to a person.

The provisions of this Article shall not apply if by gravity the act is constitutive of a crime.

#### ARTICLE 419

In the same penalty as that established in the preceding article shall incur whoever conceals their true name, status or domicile from the authority or official who asks them for reasons of their office.

#### ARTICLE 420

In the same sanction of Article 413, shall incur whoever exercises without a degree acts of a profession that requires it, when the act does not have a greater penalty assigned in this Code or in other laws.
FINAL TITLE SOLE CHAPTER
TRANSITIONAL AND FINAL PROVISIONS

#### ARTICLE 421

If according to this Code the acts being tried or on which no sentence has been rendered, do not constitute a crime or violation, the courts shall issue a dismissal or the imposed penalty shall cease to be executed.

#### ARTICLE 422

The penalties of imprisonment, relegation, confinement and banishment applied in accordance with the Penal Code of 1906, other Codes and other special laws, shall be replaced by confinement without any modification regarding their duration, unless the sanctions contemplated in this Code are more lenient, in which case these shall be applicable; likewise, the penalty of suspension shall be converted ex officio into that of special disqualification.

#### ARTICLE 423

The institutions of "Conditional Suspension of the Execution of the Penalty" and "Conditional Release" shall be applicable to those who have been convicted by virtue of previous laws.

#### ARTICLE 424

The time periods established in this Code for the prescription of the crime, of the criminal action and of the penalty shall apply to those who have violated previous criminal laws, provided that said time periods are more favorable.

#### ARTICLE 425

Only persons responsible for crimes, whose maximum penalty does not exceed five years, may be heard at liberty during the trial, if they provide the respective bond in accordance with the law.

#### ARTICULO 426

El presente Código enterará en vigencia un año después de su publicación en el Diario Oficial "La Gaceta", y desde esa fecha quedará derogado el Código Penal decretado el ocho de febrero de mil novecientos seis, sus reformas y demás disposiciones que se le opongan.

Dado en la ciudad de Tegucigalpa, Distrio (sic) Central, en el Salón de Sesiones del Congreso Nacional, a los veintitrés días del mes de agosto de mil novecientos ochenta y tres.

Jóse Efrain Bú Girón, Presidente.

Ignacio Alberto Rodríguez Espinoza, Secretario.
Juan Pablo Urrutia Raudales, Secretario.

Al Poder Ejecutivo.
Por tanto: Ejecútese.

Tegucigalpa, D. C., 26 de septiembre de 1983.

ROBERTO SUAZO CORDOVA
Presidente.

El Secretario de Estado en los Despachos de Gobernación y Justicia, Oscar Mejía Arellano.

To the Executive Branch.
